description: BOISE, Idaho — Lori Hickman, Democratic candidate for Idaho Attorney General, is proud to announce that she has received the endorsement of Veterans for Idaho Voters (V4IV), a nonpartisan organization of Idaho veterans committed to upholding the Constitution, the rule of law, and the rights of all Idahoans. Hickman was the first Democratic candidate to earn this endorsement."Lori Hickman is an experienced Idaho attorney who understands that the Attorney General's job is to apply the law faithful
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lori for Idaho, Karen Lansing, Treasurer bottom of page
title: Veterans for Idaho Voters Endorses Lori Hickman for Idaho Attorney General
